1. Go to **Reports** and select **Saved**.
2. Open the report.
3. Select **Add note** below the title.
4. Type your note, for example what the report is used for.
5. Select **Save**.
The note is shown at the top of the report and in PDF exports.

title: Share a report with a client
aliases: send a report link to a customer
give a client access to a report
how do I share a report with a client
body:
1. Open the saved report from **Reports**.
2. Select **Share**.
3. Choose **Share with client** and select the client.
4. Select **Copy link** or **Send email**.
Clients see a read-only view of this report only. Select **Stop sharing** to turn the access off.

title: Invite a member to the workspace
aliases: send an invitation to a colleague
body:
1. Go to **Workspace** and select **Members**.
2. Select **Invite member**.
3. Enter their email address and choose a role.
4. Select **Send invite**.
They receive an email with a link to set a password. Invites expire after 14 days.

title: Resend an invitation
body:
1. Go to **Workspace** and select **Members**.
2. Select the **Invited** tab.
3. Find the person and select **Resend invite**.
A new link is emailed and the 14-day expiry restarts. Ask them to check their junk folder if it still doesn't arrive.

title: Change a member's role
body:
1. Go to **Workspace** and select **Members**.
2. Select the member's name.
3. Choose a new **Role**: **Admin**, **Project manager** or **Member**.
4. Select **Save**.
The new permissions apply the next time they load a page.

title: Update a member's phone number
aliases: correct a phone number on a profile
body:
1. Go to **Workspace** and select **Members**.
2. Select the member's name.
3. Select **Edit** beside **Phone**.
4. Enter the new number.
5. Select **Save**.
Members can also update their own number from **Profile**.
The change is recorded in the activity log for your workspace.

title: Update a member's email address
aliases: new work email for a member
body:
1. Go to **Workspace** and select **Members**.
2. Select the member's name.
3. Select **Edit** beside **Email**.
4. Enter the new address.
5. Select **Save**.
We email the new address to confirm it. The member keeps signing in with the old address until they confirm.

title: Deactivate a member
body:
1. Go to **Workspace** and select **Members**.
2. Select the member's name.
3. Select **Deactivate member**.
4. Choose someone to take over their open tasks, or leave them unassigned.
5. Confirm by selecting **Deactivate**.
Their time entries and history are kept. Deactivated members no longer count towards your plan.

title: Reactivate a member
aliases: restore access for a deactivated person
how do I reactivate a member
body:
1. Go to **Workspace** and select **Members**.
2. Select the **Deactivated** tab.
3. Select the member's name.
4. Select **Reactivate member** and confirm their role.
They can sign in again straight away. Tasks that were reassigned stay with the new owner.

title: Add a guest to a project
aliases: let a client view a project
body:
1. Open the project from **Projects**.
2. Select **Share**.
3. Select **Add guest** and enter their email address.
4. Choose **View only** or **Can comment**.
5. Select **Send invite**.
Guests only see this project and do not count as members.

title: Remove a guest
body:
1. Go to **Workspace** and select **Guests**.
2. Select the guest's name.
3. Select **Remove guest**.
4. Confirm by selecting **Remove**.
They lose access to all shared projects immediately. Their past comments stay visible.
You can reverse this at any time by repeating the steps.

title: Change the workspace name
aliases: how do I change the workspace name
body:
1. Go to **Settings** and select **Workspace**.
2. Edit the **Workspace name** field.
3. Select **Save**.
The new name appears in the sidebar, in emails and on invoices. Only admins can change it.
You can reverse this at any time by repeating the steps.

title: Set the workspace time zone
aliases: how do I set the workspace time zone
body:
1. Go to **Settings** and select **Workspace**.
2. Select **Time zone**.
3. Choose a time zone from the list.
4. Select **Save**.
Due dates, reports and scheduled emails use this time zone. Members can set their own under **Profile**.

title: Set the working week
aliases: choose which days are work days
how do I set the working week
body:
1. Go to **Settings** and select **Workspace**.
2. Under **Working week**, tick the days your team normally works.
3. Enter the standard hours for each day.
4. Select **Save**.
Timesheets and utilisation reports use these days to work out expected hours.

title: Create a team
body:
1. Go to **Workspace** and select **Teams**.
2. Select **New team**.
3. Enter a team name.
4. Choose the members to add.
5. Select **Create team**.
Teams can be used to filter reports and to assign projects.

title: Export the member list to CSV
aliases: get employee list in a spreadsheet
how do I export the member list to csv
body:
1. Go to **Workspace** and select **Members**.
2. Use the filters if you only want some members.
3. Select **Export**.
4. Choose **CSV**.
The file lists each member's name, email, phone, role and status.
You can reverse this at any time by repeating the steps.

title: Transfer workspace ownership
aliases: how do I transfer workspace ownership
body:
1. Go to **Settings** and select **Workspace**.
2. Scroll to **Ownership** and select **Transfer ownership**.
3. Choose an existing admin.
4. Enter your password to confirm.
5. Select **Transfer**.
You stay on as an admin. The new owner receives an email confirming the change.
